reviews.text: This is one of the best kennels in yorkshire  your pet is extremely well cared for and spoilt  especially if its their birthday  gthey get a cake and party hat etc and photo sent to owner because its so good you have to book well in advance to avoid dissappointment
My girl loves the staff there and you know that they look after the animals as if they were their own

We've used this 5****  Laburnum Kennels for the past 23 years for our four dogs. We currently have two that are boarded together in one kennel. They have ice creams and fans in summer, and hot treats in winter. We wouldn't use anywhere else. All staff treat your furbaby as if they are their own. Staff are trained and compassionate, caring and knowledgeable and most have been there almost as long as we've used them.  Wouldn't recommend anywhere else.
My dog Reggie was well looked after and came out very happy and not Smelly. The staff were all lovely too I will definitely use again thank you fore looking after him

Our Bailey had been due to spend 2 weeks at Laburnum but sadly we've had to cancel due to declining health. We've had to make a decision in his best interests and try to make his last week as comfortable as possible. I would like to thank all at Laburnum who were willing to take him despite his age and health. He spent a day with the folks at Laburnum so he could get used to being there( at no cost) The team were brilliant with him on the day, and also very understanding on the phone when I spoke about Bailey. Highly recommended

Was so nervous about putting Keith in the kennels for the weekend however all of the staff completely put me at ease and Keith has come home today happy as ever. Thank you so much and Keith looks forward to staying with you again. Can’t thank you all enough ❤️

Used laburnum for few years now and my two Dogs love it here.
Great place ,staff always brilliant,helpful and accommodating.
I always feel at ease knowing my two are here and wouldn't use anywhere else

Absolutely amazing staff. Looked after our two pups so well. They came home happy and healthy and couldn’t wish for a better service. Thank you Brilliant service. Will only book in with you guys in future xx

I boarded my cats here for a week in July 2025 and at that time they were well cared for, so I felt comfortable returning in January 2026. Unfortunately, this second experience was completely different and very upsetting.

When I collected my cats, I was shocked by the condition of their accommodation. Their litter tray had not been emptied, there was faeces on the floor, no water or heating available, and their cat basket was soiled with faeces. I had also specifically requested that my cats only be fed the required daily amount, yet all of their food had been dumped into the kennel and the food container left on the floor.

I asked staff for an explanation but was told that no one could account for what had happened because everyone “hadn’t been on duty.” This lack of accountability, combined with the conditions my cats were kept in, felt like complete neglect.

Given my experience, I would not recommend this cattery unless significant improvements are made to care standards and supervision.
Lovely caring staff
Taco had a great time and will for sure use again!
Great kennels, staff brilliant, dogs came home happy

So grateful to have found Laburnum kennels. It was my beagle’s first time in kennels in over three years and I was very anxious leaving him, but the team completely put my mind at ease and as soon as I saw him when I collected him I knew he had been shown nothing but love and care during his stay. Especially grateful for the pictures of him during his stay and the contact from the team while we were apart. He will definitely be coming to stay at Laburnum again in the future. Thank you so much.

The only people we trust with our dogs. The staff and facilities are brilliant. Can never do enough to help you and are really lovely people who take pride in caring for animals. Cannot recommend highly enough.

Our German Shepherd, Jackson, is reactive and nervous around strangers and other dogs - but the team have spent time getting to know him before he first stayed and he has gotten to the point now where he genuinely seems to enjoy his time there with them and his sister Abbie.

The team always put our minds at ease and always send photos/updates. Best boarding kennels around!

I couldn’t be happier with the care my dog received at Laburnum Kennels. The staff are warm, professional, and clearly passionate about animals. I was given regular updates, which really put my mind at ease while I was away. My dog came home happy, healthy, and well looked after. The facilities are clean and secure, and it’s clear the dogs are treated like family. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a safe and loving environment for their pet 😊
